title: CoreWeave confirms Nvidia partnership stability amid board investigation
digest:
CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator confirmed on November 11 that its partnership with Nvidia remains unchanged, despite ongoing board investigations into potential conflicts of interest. The stability is backed by a recent AI-factory capacity expansion and improved market sentiment reflected in reduced bankruptcy risk metrics. 

Intrator emphasized the partnership’s role in CoreWeave’s financial health and AI strategy, with Nvidia’s CEO currently under investigation for unrelated misconduct. 

Key conditions include: 1) Nvidia partnership expanded via AI-factory upgrades; 2) CoreWeave’s revenue growth linked to partnership stability; 3) Market data shows bankruptcy risk下降 18.7% since October 2026. 

Future developments depend on Nvidia’s CEO probe conclusion and CoreWeave’s Q4 2026 strategic roadmap disclosures.
